sample_unit: participants (patients, frontline clinicians, senior wound nurses, product manager)
models_evaluated: AI-enabled wound care application with virtual command centre

links.outcome: Clinician-reported barriers to workflow integration of the AI wound app, including time and training burden
links.effect: Frontline clinicians valued enhanced documentation consistency but reported barriers including time pressures and training burden; workflow integration was flagged as a priority area for future investment.
links.quote: Frontline clinicians valued enhanced documentation consistency but reported barriers including time pressures and training burden.

screen.reason: Evaluates user experience, workflow integration, and perspectives following the real deployment of an AI-enabled digital wound care model across multiple hospitals and clinics.
